item.description: The function fails when the hera__outputs_directory environment variable is not set, causing a TypeError when trying to perform path operations with None values.
item.contract: When hera__outputs_directory environment variable is not set or is None, the function should default to "/tmp/hera-outputs" and not cause TypeError when performing path operations.

item.description: Function attempts to create a Path object by joining a Path with None, causing TypeError when artifact paths are not properly resolved.
item.contract: When creating output paths for artifacts or parameters, the function should handle cases where path components might be None and gracefully default to valid paths.

item.description: Function fails type validation when comparing annotated types with actual return values, particularly for generic types like Dict and List.
item.contract: When validating annotated return types, the function should properly handle generic types like typing.Dict[str, str] and typing.List[str] and compare them with their concrete Python equivalents.

item.description: Function tries to perform path operations with None values when artifact paths are not properly initialized.
item.contract: When constructing artifact paths for input artifacts, the function should properly handle cases where artifact paths or names are None and fall back to default paths.

item.description: Function fails to properly resolve parameter names when dealing with kebab-case to snake_case conversion, leading to missing parameter values.
item.contract: When mapping function annotations to template inputs, the function should properly resolve parameter names using multiple strategies including kebab-case to snake_case conversion.
